context:
The smart field-count detection from FormatConverter._needs_trailing_dummy_column() is the
canonical approach: read the first non-empty line, split by delimiter, compare field count
to expected column count. This correctly handles both TPC-H files (which have trailing |)
and TPC-DS files like time_dim.dat (which do not). Move this logic to file_format.py as
the single source of truth, then update all 13 call sites to use it. For SQL adapters,
only standardize the column name -- the unconditional add-then-drop pattern is safe there.
description:
TPC benchmark data files (.tbl/.dat) use | as a field terminator (not separator),
creating an extra empty field when split. This is currently handled in 13+ locations
across 9 files using 3 different detection approaches and 3 different dummy column
names (_trailing_, _trailing_delimiter, _trailing_ignore). The inconsistency caused
regressions (e.g., time_dim.dat conversion failure where the naive "ends with |"
check incorrectly added a dummy column).

Approach: Extract the smart field-count detection logic into benchbox/utils/file_format.py
as a shared utility. Update all 13 locations to use the shared constant and, where
appropriate, the shared detection function. Remove has_trailing_delimiter from
FileFormatInfo (it's always False -- dead code).

anti_patterns.dont: unconditionally add dummy columns in DataFrame adapters
anti_patterns.why: it breaks when the file has no trailing delimiter (extra NaN column)

anti_patterns.dont: use delimiter == '|' as a proxy for has_trailing_delimiter
anti_patterns.why: not all pipe-delimited files have trailing pipes
it incorrectly flags TPC-DS files like time_dim.dat that end with | as field content

preserves.behavior: All existing TPC-H and TPC-DS data loading must continue to work identically
Compressed file support in trailing delimiter detection (via CompressionManager)
DuckDB SQL EXCLUDE pattern and PyArrow include_columns filtering remain unconditional (they handle both with/without trailing delimiter)
Schema-less fallback for has_trailing_delimiter when column_names is None

verifications.command: uv run benchbox run --platform datafusion --benchmark tpcds --scale 0.01 --mode dataframe
verifications.description: TPC-DS time_dim loads correctly via DataFusion DataFrame mode
No stale trailing column references remain
verifications.expected: Only references to TRAILING_DUMMY_COLUMN or its value '_trailing_delimiter_'
